intro: One playthrough is enough for all 55 trophies — there are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals. The run is long, not hard: launch-era guides put it at around 200 hours. Work the stages in order, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and never use cheats on your trophy save (cheats switch trophies and saving off).

stages.body: Turn cheats off and leave them off. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, and no mission replay or New Game Plus — keep one save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission, and rotate the rest. In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony): it is the one thing that can be missed.
stages.title: Before you start

stages.body: Play the story straight through. All 12 chapter and named-mission trophies pop as you go, and the final mission pays the gold. Do the Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon, time-sensitive, counts toward Strangers & Freaks), and take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 to unlock bank-vault robberies.
stages.title: The story — Chapters 1 to 4
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.body: Finish the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each end in a finale trophy, and 8 other stranger strands make Strangers & Freaks. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers & Freaks because they have their own trophies. All side-story finales stay open after the credits.
stages.title: Side stories

stages.body: The one-off feats, most of them quick: steal a jet from a VCIA boarding bridge, climb into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, rob a jewelry store unseen with the Snap Gun, rob three shops in a row with your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, and take down five enemies in one Combat Focus. Partner trophies need Jason and Lucia together, which opens in Chapter 2.
stages.title: Free-roam firsts

stages.body: Meditate at every spot (do the Chapter 1 balcony one first — it is missable), finish three card sets, WAiNK 100 locations, scan 100 vehicles, buy all eight garages, register ten cars with Scooter Bros, and explore all of Leonida. Fold all of these into normal travel so the cleanup is short.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration
stages.when: Throughout, cleaned up after the story

stages.body: The 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 vaults, all 39 illegal operations, 42 shooting-range golds, a drone win at all 14 locations, 20 race wins and $250,000 of laundered marked bills. Most of it is already half done if you played the earlier stages properly. When A Long Road pops, the Platinum follows.
